source.method: zones.bin + canonical station groups + gravity/IPF + POI priors

notes: Demand points use zones.bin population/jobs proxies, not a census.
OD is a doubly constrained gravity/IPF estimate at station-group level.
Access uses straight-line distance with a detour factor; no pedestrian graph.
Access covers 1716/3194 points; unserved demand is excluded from this pack.
Special POI demand: 25 hotspots, 400 groups; transit shares are research priors.
The group cap represents 31.0% of estimated trips.
